name: kb_983_Normalized

schema.description: ServiceReference holds a reference to Service.legacy.k8s.io

name.description: `name` is the name of the service. Required

namespace.description: `namespace` is the namespace of the service. Required

path.description: `path` is an optional URL path which will be sent in any request to this service.

port.description: If specified, the port on the service that hosting webhook. Default to 443 for backward compatibility. `port` should be a valid port number (1-65535, inclusive).

description: Please configure the webhook to target the service named **my-service** located in the **default** namespace. The endpoint for requests should use the URL path **/webhook**, and the service listens on port **8443**. Let me know once the settings have been applied so we can verify the integration.
